title: Detox Pipeline Run Record
description: Denormalized summary of a single Detox CWE remediation pipeline run. One record per pipeline execution. Source: scripts/telemetry/run_recorder.py build_run_record() — this is the full LOCAL record (~/.detox/telemetry/runs.jsonl). TRANSPORT: exported to the Barclays Observe platform via gRPC OTLP as the 'detox.pipeline_run' event (fields become detox.* labels), batched together with the run's granular events at pipeline end. NOTE: four local fields are NOT exported as Observe labels (unchanged from the prior exporter): 'ended_at' becomes the record timestamp; 'started_at', 'ci_job_id', 'retries_total', and 'project_path' are retained locally but not sent. This schema remains the primary definition for a database materialisation of the local record.

job_id.description: Unique pipeline run identifier (8 hex characters). Primary key.

command.description: The Detox command that was invoked.

total_duration_ms.description: Total pipeline duration in milliseconds. Computed: ended_at - started_at.

user_name.description: Developer or CI user who triggered the pipeline. Resolved from CI env vars > git config > $USER.

user_email.description: Developer email. Resolved from CI env vars > git config. May be empty string.

cio.description: Barclays CIO of the user who ran the pipeline (barclays_cio from the mandatory Claude Code user setup, ~/.claude/settings.json). Used for adoption attribution by CIO. Null if setup incomplete.

ci_job_id.description: CI job identifier. Populated only for CI runs (GitLab CI_JOB_ID / Jenkins BUILD_NUMBER / GitHub GITHUB_RUN_ID). Null for local runs.

model.description: LLM model used for the pipeline run.

project_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the target repository on the machine that ran the pipeline.

repo_name.description: Short repository name. Extracted from git remote URL or directory name.

severity_filter.description: Which vulnerability severities were included in this run.

dry_run.description: True if the pipeline ran in preview mode (no actual code changes).

vulns_total.description: Total number of vulnerabilities parsed from input reports.

vulns_by_severity.description: Vulnerability count grouped by severity level.

vulns_by_type.description: Vulnerability count grouped by remediation type.

cwes_targeted.description: Sorted list of unique CWE IDs addressed in this run.

fixes_attempted.description: Number of CWE fix attempts (total = succeeded + failed + skipped).

fixes_succeeded.description: Number of fixes that were successfully applied and committed.

fixes_failed.description: Number of fixes that failed to apply.

fixes_skipped.description: Number of fixes skipped (e.g., file not found, not applicable).

retries_total.description: Total retry attempts across all fix operations.

fixes_validated_clean.description: Fixes that passed BOTH stages: the edit applied (status=success) AND the post-fix re-scan confirmed the vulnerability is gone (validation_passed=true). The 'verified fixed' count — distinct from fixes_succeeded, which only means the edit was applied.

vulns_deferred.description: Vulnerabilities found but never attempted (deferred to manual review / major upgrade / out of auto-remediation scope). Reconciles the total: vulns_total = fixes_attempted + vulns_deferred.

vulns_deferred_by_reason.description: Count of Stage 8 state.unresolved_items bucketed by remediation_type (partially_addressed, out_of_repo, manual, hybrid, not_applicable, likely_unexploitable). Items without a remediation_type count as "unspecified". Does NOT reconcile to vulns_deferred (hybrid/manual-review items were attempted fixes) and is {} if the run aborts before Stage 8.

fixes_unverified_by_reason.description: WHY attempted fixes are not verified-clean — count bucketed by reason (still_detected = re-scan still flags it; fix_failed; skipped; not_validated; unknown_status). Sums to (fixes_attempted - fixes_validated_clean).

unresolved_vulns.description: One entry per in-scope finding not fixed (excludes dry runs and severity-filtered findings). Exported on the detox.pipeline_run event as detox.unresolved_vulns (JSON string) plus detox.unresolved_vulns_count (export-only label, not stored locally), and each entry also as its own detox.vuln_unresolved event. reason is the LLM's unfixed_reason verbatim (credentials redacted), or "LLM didn't give a reason for not fixing this" when none was given.

examples.reason: Query is built in a stored procedure outside this repo

verified_remediation_rate.description: Share of all found vulnerabilities fixed AND verified clean (0.0-1.0). Null if no vulnerabilities. Computed: fixes_validated_clean / vulns_total. The strictest, most defensible success measure.

validation_pass_count.description: Number of fixes that passed Semgrep re-scan validation.

validation_fail_count.description: Number of fixes that failed Semgrep re-scan validation.

remediation_rate.description: Share of all found vulnerabilities actually fixed (0.0-1.0). Null if no vulnerabilities. Computed: fixes_succeeded / vulns_total.

fix_success_rate.description: Success rate among attempted fixes (0.0-1.0). Null if none attempted. Computed: fixes_succeeded / fixes_attempted.

fix_failure_rate.description: Failure rate among attempted fixes (0.0-1.0). Null if none attempted. Computed: fixes_failed / fixes_attempted.

deferral_rate.description: Share of found vulnerabilities not attempted (left for manual review) (0.0-1.0). Null if no vulnerabilities. Computed: (vulns_total - fixes_attempted) / vulns_total.

validation_pass_rate.description: Validation pass rate (0.0-1.0). Null if no validations were performed. Computed: pass / (pass + fail).

tests_generated.description: Number of security regression test files generated.

tests_passed.description: Number of generated tests that passed execution.

tests_failed.description: Number of generated tests that failed execution.

test_pass_rate.description: Pass rate of executed generated tests (0.0-1.0). Null if none executed. Computed: tests_passed / (tests_passed + tests_failed).

pr_created.description: Whether a merge request was created in GitLab.

pr_url.description: URL of the created merge request. Null if no MR was created.

agent_invocations.description: Number of LLM agent invocations during the pipeline run.

flags_raised.description: Governance flags raised during the run (e.g., manual_review_needed). Added by run_recorder.py: 'state_incomplete' (a PR or fix results recorded but no findings — counts were lost; banner shows a warning instead of a green tick) and 'state_file_missing' (no state file for this job could be read; counts come only from the state passed in).

self_check_passed.description: Whether the agent self-check at pipeline end passed all criteria.

phases.description: Per-phase timing and status. Keys are phase numbers (1-9) as strings.

started_at.description: Phase start timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Auto-injected by pipeline_state.py.

ended_at.description: Phase end timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Auto-injected by pipeline_state.py.

duration_ms.description: Phase duration in milliseconds. Computed: ended_at - started_at.

phase.description: Phase number where the error occurred.

error.description: Error message from the failed phase.

errors.description: List of errors from failed phases. Empty array if no failures.

plugin_version.description: Detox plugin version that produced this record. Read from .claude-plugin/plugin.json.

phase_names.description: Reference: mapping of phase numbers to pipeline stage names.
